standard_prerequisites.name: Algebraicity of H_d(X)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the smooth cover of H_d(X).

standard_prerequisites.name: Relative representability
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes H_d(X/Y) -> H_d(X) x Y representable.

standard_prerequisites.name: Bootstrap
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes algebraicity of W from its sheaf.

core_obligations: Build the 2-fibre product W over a smooth cover U of H_d(X) and show it is a stack in setoids.
Build V over U x X, show it is an algebraic space, and extract the 2-cartesian square relating V, W, X, Y.
Transfer flat/lfp/surjectivity of V -> W from F and conclude the sheaf of W is an algebraic space by Bootstrap.
proof_roadmap: Two-stage fibre-product construction with the displayed exchange identity, then property transfer through the associated sheaves and the Bootstrap theorem.
difficulty_reason: Multiple fibre-product constructions plus a displayed exchange identity and property transfer; each stage real.
